name: United Imaging
full_name: United Imaging vascular interventional robot (VascularPilot3D platform)
group: United Imaging and United Imaging Research Institute of Intelligent Imaging, with U. Michigan (Ghaffari); also used by Tongji University (Tianliang Yao, Peng Qi), Soochow University (Bo Lu), Siemens Healthineers
versions: song2025_vascularpilot3d (arXiv 2405.09375 v1 2024-05-15; ICRA 2025): United Imaging's own robot carrying the VascularPilot3D navigation stack ('Our own robot was built', Sec. III, Fig. 5) -> yao2025_sim4endor (ICRA 2025, open-loop replay) -> yao2025_sim2real (T-ASE 2025)
target_anatomy: simplified vascular phantom and complex coronary phantom
n_dof_detail: translation + rotation of the guidewire (Fig. 3 labels); count N.R.
translation_detail: N.R. (robot only described as a 'specialized vascular intervention robot provided by United Imaging')
imaging_compat: United Imaging uAngio 960 fluoroscopy, mean delay 0.2 s from the C-arm to the navigation software; pre-operative CT on uCT 860 (song2025_vascularpilot3d Sec. III)
validation_detail: Physical robot, Target B of a vascular phantom; 5 trials per RL method, 3 trials per human operator (yao2025_sim2real); autonomous navigation to 5 destinations in a transparent phantom under fluoroscopy, 5 trials each, which the paper calls ex-vivo (song2025_vascularpilot3d Sec. III, Fig. 5)
key_numbers: PPO+GAE+DR: 100 % success, 53.0 +/- 5.1 s, error 2.92 +/- 0.41 mm (A) and 2.06 +/- 0.31 mm (B); plain PPO 60 % in 61.0 +/- 4.8 s; SAC 75 % (45.0 s); DDPG 75 % (40.0 s); humans 100 % in 35.0 and 39.0 s (yao2025_sim2real); VascularPilot3D 25 of 25 autonomous navigations, 18.38 % fewer control loops than the human operator, one control step about 2 s (song2025_vascularpilot3d abstract, Sec. III)
sim_model: SOFA with BeamAdapter discrete-point guidewire model; anatomy from CT, built with Blender and Onshape; Sim4EndoR platform (yao2025_sim4endor)
sim2real_detail: yes: policy trained only in simulation (PPO with GAE and domain randomisation over friction and tissue elasticity) deployed on this robot with no real-time position feedback; sim 90 % (9/10, Target B) -> robot 100 % (5/5) (yao2025_sim2real, full). yao2025_sim4endor: robot 5/5 and 3/5, open-loop replay (S7b evidence)
